scope: Nonauthor infrastructure source audit of exactly driver preparation01; not a mathematical/manuscript review, executed test, enabled-binding receipt or root operational gate.

findings.title: Body-role reads can occur before the complete returned-path authorization gate

evidence.fact: Input shape permits body-role files with unknown content in the bodies phase; aliases have separately bound referents.
readPinned permits body + bodies phase + expected pin with content:null, then opens and reads the referent.
A receipt ref constrains lexical workspace path and pin shape but not byte-read purpose, descriptor role or resolved role.
Only bodies phase is required for body roles; alias target roles may also be body.
SELF, all receipts, outer refs, old companions and fixed profile are read before validateQueryInputs.
Query stdout/stderr/result refs are read at 695-696; complete body list and extra-body rejection follow only at 739-756.
The stated invariant is that the entire returned-path set is checked before any body bytes can be read.

symbolic_witness: No actual binding, file, symlink or input mutation is created. All letters below denote hypothetical descriptor roles in a future bodies binding.

Let q be a receipt-ref lexical path below ROOT, a symlink to regular file h. Bind all finite ancestors/aliases and matching q/h stat fields. Tag both q and h as body, with content:null; let the receipt ref have a syntactically valid complete expected pin. Neither q nor h belongs to the eventual returned-body set.
descriptorShape and validateBinding accept these role/kind/content combinations. referenceShape allows the workspace lexical q without checking whether q or its referent belongs to the body channel.
main reaches receiveRef(q) before validateQueryInputs. readPinned(q,expected) authorizes the special body path, opens h and reads its bytes before the later complete returned-set rejection.

The bootstrap reads inside validateQueryInputs have the same issue: its three q refs lack a non-body purpose check before reading. An invalid later pin or missing returned role can only reject after that read.
findings.impact: A malformed binding that should be refused before any unapproved body-byte access can cause an early body read. This is a present source invariant defect, not an observed host incident, and is separate from the correctly disclosed missing outer runtime/session implementation.
required_revision: Before any possible byte read, bind the callee purpose and validate receipt/source/runtime/query-result roles, file-or-alias kinds, resolved referent roles and required complete prebound content.
Keep those bootstrap documentary/native-result channels disjoint from the unknown-body channel; a lexical workspace path alone is insufficient.
Make body-byte permission false until every ordered returned-body authorization and every body descriptor/alias role has passed; do not let a supplied expected pin bypass that state.
Preserve preparation01 and issue a new-only source revision and exact reviewed delta. No repair is applied by this auditor.
findings.independent_consultation: context_contract/REPORT.md DCC-F1 independently reaches the same source witness.

observations.title: Selected binding-file byte stability belongs to a separate nonself outer key, not the inner mandatory input list
observations.deduction: The initial selected binding file is decoded once. filename is not mandatory in binding.inputs, and BINDING_RECEIVED records the initial parsed content. The inner final snapshot therefore does not by itself establish current binding-file byte/identity stability. The staged contract explicitly leaves an outer key and pre-startup receipt to a separate implementation.
observations.required_interpretation: The future outer source must explicitly bind initial selected binding bytes and identity and their required before/after agreement. Do not request a circular full self-hash inside BINDING.json. This does not independently block the disabled preparation beyond DQD-S1, and no accepted binding is alleged deficient.
observations.consultation: Preserves the independently recorded DCC-O1 as a coverage observation, not a second guard defect.

intended_pending_not_defects: Complete outer original product request/yield/poll/final envelopes, native product handle and broader owned-session/intervention/member reception require a separately received implementation before startup.
